papers_and_supporting_note.scope: Supplied surjective holomorphic pi:X->B between connected smooth compact Kahler manifolds, dim X=n>nu=dim B>=1, beta Kahler, theta=pi*beta, m=n-nu. Critical and dimension-jumping fibres included, with no connected-fibre assumption for the main theorem. Globally bounded beta-psh phi and bounded admissible u_epsilon uniformly converging to pi*phi; u_epsilon need not descend and no epsilon-relative rate is required. All auxiliary Kahler classes after the explicit c_omega=pi_*(omega^m)>0 calibration; smoothly converging auxiliary paths with Kahler limit included. Raw base mass is int_B beta^nu. The pushforward of (theta+epsilon omega+ddc u_epsilon)^n divided by binom(n,nu)c_omega epsilon^m converges against every continuous base test to (beta+ddc phi)^nu. Supporting bounded energy, cocycle and affine variation laws and compensating base representative changes are proved. This requires a supplied fibration and pullback Kahler class. No canonical carrier for general pseudoeffective classes, minimum necessary reference data, unbounded prescribed singularity type or E1 completion, or arbitrary degenerate auxiliary path is proved. The original problem remains open.
